_readme: The article drafting queue. One entry becomes one trade article in the
house pattern: question in the title, honest answer, embedded tool,
steps, FAQ, lead form. docs/article-drafting.md describes the pipeline.
npm run draft:article emits the next brief; --claim marks it drafted.
Statuses: queued -> drafted -> scheduled (authored and dated) -> published.
Scheduled is not deployment proof; published requires a verified live URL.
Record deployment and live checks in content/article-publications/.
Add new entries at the end. Every tool slug must exist in lib/tools and
each tool may appear once, because its OG card becomes the article scene.
Tool-coverage editorial briefs: docs/tool-article-coverage-plan-2026-09-06.json. Match queueSlug for the worked example, reader artifact, actual inputs, and source-review requirements.
The September 6, 2026 tool-guide batch contains 45 guides verified live at 2026-09-07T06:30:36.146Z. Existing September 7 and 8 daily dates are preserved.
